mapper.select: SELECT USR.U_IDX, USR.U_ID, USR.U_C_IDX, USR.U_PASSWORD, USR.U_NICNAME, USR.U_EMAIL, USR.U_PHONE, USR.U_FILE, DATE_FORMAT(USR.U_JOINDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS U_JOINDATE, USR.U_WITHDRAW, USR.U_REVIEW, USR.U_STATUS, COP.C_NAME FROM USER AS USR LEFT JOIN COMPANY AS COP ON COP.C_IDX = USR.U_C_IDX WHERE U_IDX = #{U_IDX}

SELECT REW.R_IDX AS R_IDX, REW.R_C_IDX AS R_C_IDX, REW.R_U_IDX AS R_U_IDX, REW.R_STAR AS R_STAR, REW.R_TITLE AS R_TITLE, REW.R_CONTENT AS R_CONTENT, REW.R_DATE AS R_DATE, REW.R_WORK AS R_WORK, USR.U_NICNAME AS U_NICNAME, COP.C_NICNAME AS C_NICNAME FROM REVIEW AS REW INNER JOIN USER AS USR ON REW.R_U_IDX = USR.U_IDX LEFT JOIN COMPANY AS COP ON COP.C_IDX = USR.U_C_IDX WHERE USR.U_IDX = #{u_idx}
